Title: General availability: Public IP per node capability in AKS

Body.Content:
We are announcing general availability of public IP per node capability in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

With this feature, a given node can now be directly accessed instead of through a load balancer. This enables you to implement scenarios, such as those involving gaming workloads, where nodes in a node pool need dedicated public IP addresses to minimize delays.

Learn more.
